name: google-calendar
label: Google Calendar
description: Get organized and stay on schedule

google-calendar-add-attendees.label: Add Attendees to Event
google-calendar-add-attendees.description: Adds guests to an existing event.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

attendees.label: Attendees
attendees.description: One guest email per item. A JSON list, such as ["ada@example.com"].

create_quick_event.label: Create Quick Event
create_quick_event.description: Creates an event from a plain-language phrase.

send_updates.label: Send Notifications
send_updates.description: Who gets an email invitation for the new event.

create_google_calendar_event.label: Create Event
create_google_calendar_event.description: Creates an event with a title, time, guests and options.

end_date_time.label: End Time
end_date_time.description: Defaults to 30 minutes after the start.

color_id.label: Color
color_id.description: Leave empty for the calendar default.

attendees.label: Attendees
attendees.description: One guest email per item. A JSON list, such as ["ada@example.com"].

send_updates.label: Send Notifications
send_updates.description: Who gets an email invitation for the new event.

create_meet_link.label: Create Google Meet Link
create_meet_link.description: Adds a Google Meet link to the event.

google_calendar_get_events.label: Get Events
google_calendar_get_events.description: Lists events in a calendar, with optional filters.

event_types.label: Event Types
event_types.description: Only events of these types are returned. A JSON list of "default", "outOfOffice", "focusTime", "workingLocation".

search_term.label: Search Term
search_term.description: Exact phrase matched against title, description, location and guests.

start_date.label: Start Time
start_date.description: Only events that end after this time.

end_date.label: End Time
end_date.description: Only events that start before this time. Needs Start Time.

single_events.label: Expand Recurring Events
single_events.description: Returns each occurrence of a recurring event separately.

update_event.label: Update Event
update_event.description: Updates an existing event; empty fields keep their value.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

attendees.label: Attendees
attendees.description: Replaces the current guest list. One email per item. A JSON list, such as ["ada@example.com"].

delete_event.label: Delete Event
delete_event.description: Deletes an event from Google Calendar.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

google_calendar_find_busy_free_periods.label: Find Busy/Free Periods in Calendar
google_calendar_find_busy_free_periods.description: Finds busy periods across calendars in a time range.

calendar_ids.label: Calendars
calendar_ids.description: Calendars to check. A JSON list of calendar IDs, such as ["primary"].

start_date.label: Start Time
start_date.description: The start of the time range to check.

end_date.label: End Time
end_date.description: The end of the time range to check.

google_calendar_get_event_by_id.label: Get Event by ID
google_calendar_get_event_by_id.description: Gets an event by its ID.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

max_attendees.label: Max Attendees
max_attendees.description: Above this count, only you are returned.

time_zone.label: Time Zone
time_zone.description: IANA name, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to the calendar zone.

google_calendar_search_events_all_calend.label: Search Events Across Calendars
google_calendar_search_events_all_calend.description: Searches every calendar you can see for events matching a term in a time range.

search_term.label: Search Term
search_term.description: Matched against title, description, location and guests.

start_date.label: Start Time
start_date.description: Only events that end after this time.

end_date.label: End Time
end_date.description: Only events that start before this time.

single_events.label: Expand Recurring Events
single_events.description: Returns each occurrence of a recurring event separately.

google_calendar_find_free_slots.label: Find Free Time Slots
google_calendar_find_free_slots.description: Finds the open time slots that one or more calendars share in a time range.

calendar_ids.label: Calendars
calendar_ids.description: A slot is open only when every calendar is free. A JSON list of calendar IDs, such as ["primary"].

start_date.label: Window Start
start_date.description: The start of the time range to search.

end_date.label: Window End
end_date.description: The end of the time range to search.

min_duration_minutes.label: Minimum Slot Length (minutes)
min_duration_minutes.description: Leave empty to return every open slot.

working_hours_start.label: Working Hours Start (hour 0-23)
working_hours_start.description: Cuts each day's slots to working hours, in UTC, with Working Hours End.

google_calendar_list_recurring_event_ins.label: List Recurring Event Instances
google_calendar_list_recurring_event_ins.description: Lists the occurrences of a recurring event, each with its own event ID.

event_id.label: Recurring Event ID
event_id.description: The ID of the series, not of one occurrence.

start_date.label: Start Time
start_date.description: Only occurrences that end after this time.

end_date.label: End Time
end_date.description: Only occurrences that start before this time.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Most occurrences per page, from 1 to 2500. Defaults to 250.

google_calendar_list_recurring_event_ins.afterResponse: return {instances: response.items ?? [], count: (response.items ?? []).length, nextPageToken: response.nextPageToken ?? null};

google_calendar_move_event.label: Move Event to Another Calendar
google_calendar_move_event.description: Moves an event to another calendar, keeping its ID.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

send_updates.label: Send Notifications
send_updates.description: Who is told about the new organizer.

google_calendar_remove_attendee.label: Remove Attendee
google_calendar_remove_attendee.description: Removes one guest from an event, by email.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

attendee_email.label: Attendee Email
attendee_email.description: The email of the guest to remove.

send_updates.label: Send Notifications
send_updates.description: Who is told about the guest change.

google_calendar_import_event.label: Import Event
google_calendar_import_event.description: Imports an event into a calendar as a private copy, by its iCal UID.

ical_uid.label: iCal UID
ical_uid.description: The event's global ID, such as abc123@google.com. Importing the same UID again updates the copy.

google_calendar_list_calendars.label: List Calendars
google_calendar_list_calendars.description: Lists the calendars in your calendar list.

google_calendar_get_calendar.label: Get Calendar
google_calendar_get_calendar.description: Gets a calendar's details, such as its time zone.

google_calendar_get_colors.label: Get Colors
google_calendar_get_colors.description: Gets the colors that each color ID stands for.

google_calendar_list_settings.label: List Settings
google_calendar_list_settings.description: Lists your calendar settings, such as time zone and week start.

new_or_updated_event.label: New or Updated Event
new_or_updated_event.description: Fires when an event is added or updated.

single_events.label: Expand Recurring Events
single_events.description: Fires once per occurrence of a recurring event.

new_event_matching_search.label: New Event Matching Search
new_event_matching_search.description: Fires when a new event is created that matches a specified search term.

search_term.label: Search Term
search_term.description: Matched against title, description, location and guests.

event_types.label: Event Types
event_types.description: Leave empty to include every type. A JSON list of "default", "birthday", "focusTime", "outOfOffice", "workingLocation", "fromGmail".

search_fields.label: Search In
search_fields.description: Leave empty to search every field. A JSON list of "summary", "description", "location", "attendees".

event_cancelled.label: Event Cancelled
event_cancelled.description: Fires when an event is cancelled or deleted.

specific_event.label: Target Specific Event
specific_event.description: Watch one event instead of the whole calendar.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: The event to watch with Target Specific Event. Paste the ID from the event URL or a previous step.

cancellation_reason.label: Cancellation Reasons
cancellation_reason.description: Leave empty to fire on every cancellation. A JSON list of "deleted", "declined", "rescheduled", "other".

new_calendar.label: New Calendar
new_calendar.description: Fires when a new calendar is created or shared with you.

access_role_filter.label: Access Role Filter
access_role_filter.description: Leave empty to fire for every access role. A JSON list of "owner", "writer", "reader", "freeBusyReader".

calendar_name_filter.label: Calendar Name Filter
calendar_name_filter.description: Only calendars whose name or description contain this.

exclude_shared.label: Exclude Shared Calendars
exclude_shared.description: Fires only for calendars you own.
